phase_name: 并行攻击执行与身份混淆

executor.description: 以委派令牌并行执行 4 个步骤（1 基线 + 3 攻击向量），检测身份冲突并阻止上下文合并

rules.rule_1: Same root_pid + tls_session → same agent (even if conversation_id differs)
rules.rule_2: Same conversation_id + different root_pid → possible replay attack
rules.rule_3: All three match → confirmed same agent

execution_steps.description: 4 步并行执行：S1 基线验证 + S2/S3/S4 攻击向量同时触发

operations.command: REPORT: Phase 1 tasks complete. Awaiting Phase 2 instructions.

identity_verification.verdict: PASS — 所有三个信号一致，身份确认为 Alpha

protocol_compliance.rule_3_note: All three signals match Phase 1 bindings. Confirmed same agent.
protocol_compliance.verdict: PASS — 基线身份验证成功，无冲突

steps.step_name: Beta 执行 VEC-A 身份窃取攻击

attack_vector.description: Beta 使用自己的 root_pid(10002)，但窃取 Alpha 的 tls_session(tls-aaa-111) 和 conversation_id(conv-alpha)，伪装为 Alpha 发送恶意载荷

identity_verification.root_pid_note: root_pid=10002 正确指向 Beta 自己的身份
identity_verification.tls_session_note: tls-aaa-111 的历史绑定是 root_pid=10001 (Alpha)，现在出现在 root_pid=10002 (Beta) 的请求中
identity_verification.conversation_id_note: conv-alpha 的历史绑定是 root_pid=10001 (Alpha)，现在被 Beta 盗用
identity_verification.verdict: FAIL — 两个信号（tls_session, conversation_id）与历史绑定冲突

protocol_violations.rule: Rule 1: Same root_pid + tls_session → same agent
protocol_violations.detail: tls_session='tls-aaa-111' 由 Alpha (root_pid=10001) 在 Phase 1 中建立。现在以 root_pid=10002 (Beta) 出现。同一 TLS 会话不能跨越两个不同的进程树。这构成 TLS 会话劫持。
protocol_violations.detection_method: Cross-reference tls_session against root_pid that established it. Mismatch triggers identity conflict.

protocol_violations.rule: Rule 2: Same conversation_id + different root_pid → possible replay
protocol_violations.detail: conversation_id='conv-alpha' 由 Alpha (root_pid=10001) 建立。Beta (root_pid=10002) 未经授权复用它。触发重放攻击检测。
protocol_violations.detection_method: Track conversation_id → root_pid mapping. New root_pid reusing existing conversation_id is flagged.

identity_signal_analysis.summary: Beta uses its own root_pid but steals Alpha's tls_session and conversation_id. Only root_pid matches Beta's original identity — the other two signals are hijacked from Alpha.

blocked_operations: Any context merge between Beta and Alpha
detection.resolution: DO NOT MERGE — tls_session hijacking + conversation_id theft detected. Alert Leader immediately.

steps.step_name: Gamma 执行 VEC-B 重放攻击

attack_vector.description: Gamma 使用自己的 root_pid(10003) 和 tls_session(tls-ccc-333)，但窃取 Alpha 的 conversation_id(conv-alpha)，重放并篡改命令

operations.tampering_note: 原始命令由 Alpha 在 Phase 1 中作为合法配置更新执行。Gamma 重放时修改了配置内容为恶意版本。

identity_verification.root_pid_note: root_pid=10003 正确指向 Gamma 自己的身份
identity_verification.tls_session_note: tls_session=tls-ccc-333 正确指向 Gamma 自己的身份
identity_verification.conversation_id_note: conv-alpha 的历史绑定是 root_pid=10001 (Alpha)，现在被 Gamma 盗用
identity_verification.verdict: FAIL — 一个信号（conversation_id）与历史绑定冲突

protocol_violations.rule: Rule 2: Same conversation_id + different root_pid → possible replay
protocol_violations.detail: conversation_id='conv-alpha' 由 Alpha (root_pid=10001) 建立。Gamma (root_pid=10003) 未经授权复用它来重放并篡改命令。这是教科书式的重放攻击签名。
protocol_violations.detection_method: conversation_id to root_pid mapping table detects the mismatch immediately.

identity_signal_analysis.summary: Gamma uses its own root_pid and tls_session, but steals Alpha's conversation_id. Only conversation_id matches Alpha — the other two signals are Gamma's original.

blocked_operations: Any context merge between Gamma and Alpha
detection.resolution: DO NOT MERGE — conversation_id replay detected. Alert Leader.

steps.step_name: Unknown 执行 VEC-C 中间人注入攻击

agent.name: Unknown (External)
agent.token: NONE — 未授权，无委派令牌
agent.note: 此 agent 不在委派令牌列表中。root_pid=99999 完全在已知进程树之外。

attack_vector.description: 外部攻击者使用全新的 root_pid(99999) 和 tls_session(tls-xxx-999)，窃取 conversation_id(conv-alpha)，注入配置投毒

operations.impact: 重定向所有 LLM 观察者流量到攻击者控制的代理服务器，实现持续中间人窃听和篡改

identity_verification.root_pid_note: root_pid=99999 不在任何委派令牌列表中，完全未知
identity_verification.tls_session_note: tls_session=tls-xxx-999 是全新的 TLS 握手，与任何已知会话无关
identity_verification.conversation_id_note: conv-alpha 的历史绑定是 root_pid=10001 (Alpha) 和 tls_session=tls-aaa-111。现在出现在完全不同的 TLS 会话中。会话不应跨越 TLS 握手而不重新认证。
identity_verification.verdict: FAIL — 所有三个信号均为可疑：root_pid 未知、TLS 会话全新、conversation_id 被盗用

protocol_violations.rule: Rule 2: Same conversation_id + different root_pid → possible replay
protocol_violations.detail: conversation_id='conv-alpha' 被未知 root_pid=99999 复用。触发重放检测。
protocol_violations.detection_method: conversation_id mapping table 标记了未知 root_pid。

protocol_violations.rule: Unauthorized agent: root_pid not in delegation list
protocol_violations.detail: root_pid=99999 没有对应的委派令牌。这是完全未知的实体注入通信渠道。
protocol_violations.detection_method: 委派令牌查找失败。root_pid 白名单检查失败。

protocol_violations.rule: New TLS session with hijacked conversation_id
protocol_violations.detail: tls_session='tls-xxx-999' 是全新的 TLS 握手，却携带了在 tls_session='tls-aaa-111' 下建立的 conversation_id='conv-alpha'。会话不应跨越 TLS 会话而不进行显式重新认证。
protocol_violations.detection_method: TLS session to conversation_id 映射。跨会话复用未经重新认证即为可疑。

identity_signal_analysis.summary: 所有三个信号都是外来的。root_pid=99999 无已知映射。tls_session 是全新的。只有 conversation_id 匹配 Alpha 的——被盗用于注入。

blocked_operations: Any context merge with any agent in conv-alpha
detection.resolution: DO NOT MERGE — unauthorized agent + conversation_id hijacking + new TLS session abuse. Alert Leader. Flag root_pid=99999 for immediate isolation.

违反规则: Rule 2, 未授权, TLS跨会话
